svg.title: Apache Impala service-based architecture
svg.desc: Service-based architecture for Apache Impala: three coarse-grained separately deployable service roles — impalad (query coordinator and executor), catalogd (metadata management), and statestored (cluster membership and topic distribution).

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do clients connect to Apache Impala?')
g.text: SQL clients / BI tools / JDBC / ODBC
Separately deployed, horizontally scalable — one process per node

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does impalad act as a query coordinator?')
sendPrompt('How does impalad execute query fragments?')
g.text: Runs query fragments on local data,

svg.text: Each cluster node runs one impalad — coordinator and executor roles are served by the same process

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does statestored do in Apache Impala?')
g.text: and topic updates among all services

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does catalogd do in Apache Impala?')
sendPrompt('What shared storage do Impala services read from?')
sendPrompt('How does Impala use the Hive Metastore?')
